messages.subject: Model Identification + Error
parts:
Hi Everyone, 

I am new to lavaan and structural equation modeling and I am running into issues with model identification. Currently, I have an error message that my model may not be identified (which makes sense as I am learning more about sems). 

Some recommendations on this forum have been to add additional predictors to identify the model. I've also seen some information online about fixing factor loadings to "1" for model identification. Would that work?

For some background: The goal of this model is to understand the relationship between plant abundances and bird abundances in different habitat types over time. I've included the code I've written below just in case. 

Thank you for your help!

Tovah
